create_QAgent: create a QAgent with a model and number of actions for epsilon-greedy action selection
build_QMLP: build a QMLP neural network with linear layers and tanh activation for Q-value estimation
build_DQMLP: build a dueling QMLP network that separates value and advantage estimation for Q-values
build_CnnDQN: build a CnnDQN model with convolutional feature extractor and fully connected layers for image-based RL
build_DuelingCnnDQN: build a DuelingCnnDQN model with separate value and advantage streams for improved Q-value estimation
